novel_features.name: Bulk Categorize with Rule Generation
novel_features.description: Match transactions by merchant pattern + amount, apply a category, optionally promote the predicate to a server-side rule, and backfill historical matches in one call.
novel_features.rationale: Composite of local-store predicate match + per-row mutation + rule creation + backfill — no single Monarch endpoint exposes this combined flow.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When a user says 'all my Whole Foods runs under $40 are groceries', this is the one command that fixes 80 weeks of past misfires AND prevents future ones.

novel_features.name: Net-Worth Delta Attribution
novel_features.description: Decompose the net-worth change over a window into income, spending, market gain/loss, and transfers — the four numbers Monarch's chart hides behind a single line.
novel_features.rationale: Joins net_worth_snapshots × transactions × holdings in the local store; no Monarch API returns this attribution.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When the user asks 'why did my net worth jump $4,200 this week?', the answer is one command instead of an hour of spreadsheet work.

novel_features.name: Subscription Price-Drift Detector
novel_features.description: Detect recurring streams whose latest charge deviates from the trailing 6-month median by more than a threshold (default 5%).
novel_features.rationale: Requires local time-series over recurring_stream_id with a percentile baseline; Monarch shows next-due-date but never amount-drift.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Catches the silent Netflix-going-from-$15-to-$22 bump months before the user would notice scrolling through statements.

novel_features.name: Budget Burn Rate
novel_features.description: For each active budget, compute spend-per-day vs allocation-per-day, project month-end position, and flag categories on track to overshoot.
novel_features.rationale: Joins budgets × period-to-date transactions in the local store with projection math; Monarch's UI shows a current bar, not a pace projection.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Tells you on day 18 that groceries will overrun by $120, while there's still time to course-correct.

novel_features.name: Stale-Account Watch
novel_features.description: Surface accounts whose last_synced is past a threshold, grouped by institution, with severity sorted by financial impact (big-balance accounts first).
novel_features.rationale: Deterministic local threshold filter that catches silent connection failures; Monarch's web UI displays this inconsistently.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Tells you before you trust a net-worth number which accounts are reporting yesterday's data and which are still 2024.

novel_features.name: Cashflow Forecast
novel_features.description: Walk current balances forward N days through scheduled recurring streams and a trailing-90-day average of non-recurring outflow; emit per-day projected balance.
novel_features.rationale: No Monarch endpoint returns a forward projection; requires local simulation over recurring + balance state.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answers Wednesday's 'will Friday's rent clear?' without manual spreadsheet math.

novel_features.name: Category Leak Detection
novel_features.description: Find merchants whose transactions split across 3+ categories (likely miscategorized) and Uncategorized merchants with prior labeled history.
novel_features.rationale: Requires building a merchant×category histogram locally; no Monarch endpoint surfaces miscategorization patterns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Surfaces the cleanup work that compound over years of inconsistent tagging.

novel_features.name: Agent Context Bundle
novel_features.description: Emit one JSON blob composed of net-worth-by-type, MTD cashflow, top-10 categories, active budget burn, next-7-day recurring, and last-7-day transactions — shaped for LLM consumption.
novel_features.rationale: Composition of six local reads emitted in agent-native shape; no API call returns this bundle.
novel_features.why_it_matters: One pipe to claude lets an agent reason over the user's full financial state without losing structure to CSV exports.

novel_features.name: Goal Pacing
novel_features.description: Compute trailing-90-day contribution velocity per goal and project completion date vs target.
novel_features.rationale: Trailing-window math against goal-tagged transactions; Monarch returns target/current but no pace projection.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Tells the FIRE-tracker whether their savings rate is actually trending toward 2032 or 2035.

novel_features.name: Categorize Next
novel_features.description: Emit the oldest Uncategorized transaction with a deterministic top-1 category suggestion derived from the local merchant×category histogram. No LLM.
novel_features.rationale: Mechanical lookup from local store; replaces 'click through 80 transactions' with one command per cycle.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Turns the weekly categorize ritual into a tight pipe of suggestion → confirm → next.

novel_features.name: Monthly Reconciliation Memo
novel_features.description: Aggregate one month's transactions, budgets, net-worth-snapshots, and recurring data into a structured packet (top categories, MoM deltas, budget hits/misses, biggest charges, NW delta) ready for an LLM narrative draft.
novel_features.rationale: Composition of multiple local reads at month-end cadence, shaped for | claude piping.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Turns 'write me my monthly money summary' from a 30-minute spreadsheet pull into a single command.

narrative.headline: A single Go binary for Monarch Money with offline SQLite, agent-native JSON, and local analytics no other Monarch tool ships.
narrative.value_prop: monarch-pp-cli wraps the Monarch GraphQL surface as agent-friendly Cobra commands and adds eleven novel commands — budget burn, net-worth delta attribution, subscription drift detection, cashflow forecasting, agent context bundles, and more — that no Monarch competitor offers. Authenticate by capturing a session token from your Monarch web app and saving it via `auth set-token`.
narrative.auth_narrative: Monarch has no public API. Capture a session token from your logged-in Monarch web app (Chrome DevTools → Application → Cookies → look for the Authorization Token cookie/header) and pass it to `monarch-pp-cli auth set-token <token>`. Or set `MONARCH_TOKEN` in your environment. Tokens last several months. Interactive `auth login --chrome` cookie import and `--email --password --mfa` headless login are tracked as v0.2 work; until then the env-var / set-token path is the supported flow.

quickstart.comment: Save your captured Monarch session token to the local config (one-time).
Verify auth and reachability before issuing real commands.
Emit one JSON blob covering net worth, cashflow, budgets, and upcoming bills — pipe to Claude.
Show which budgets are projected to overshoot before month-end.
Find subscriptions whose price quietly changed.

troubleshoots.fix: Token expired or session stale: capture a fresh token from your Monarch web app and re-run `monarch-pp-cli auth set-token <token>`, or update `MONARCH_TOKEN` in your environment.
Run `monarch-pp-cli accounts stale --threshold 24h` — if institutions are stale, run `monarch-pp-cli accounts refresh --wait` then re-sync.
Monarch occasionally renames operations. Run `monarch-pp-cli doctor` to validate endpoints; update the binary with `go install github.com/<owner>/monarch-pp-cli@latest`.
FTS index rebuilds after each sync. If `search` is empty after sync, run `monarch-pp-cli sync --rebuild-index`.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for monarch-pp-cli when an agent needs typed access to a user's Monarch Money data — for monthly reconciliation memos, budget burn analysis, subscription drift detection, or composing cashflow forecasts. The novel-feature commands compose multiple GraphQL reads into single agent-shaped JSON outputs that no single Monarch API call answers. Set `MONARCH_TOKEN` from a captured session token for both interactive and CI use.
